result.summary: Found 1 major broken data display issue and 1 minor layout concern. The most obvious defect is a delivery fee rendering as “€NaN”.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows “€NaN delivery”, indicating a missing/invalid delivery fee value being rendered directly to users.
issues.suggestion: Validate delivery fee data before rendering; show a fallback such as “Delivery unavailable”, “Free delivery”, or hide the fee until valid data loads.

issues.description: The right edge of the horizontal category/filter row and the third “Fastest near you” card are visually clipped, which can look like content is cut off even if scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal scroll affordance, edge fade, or adjust padding/card widths so partially visible items feel intentional.
